**Direct answer:** No. Today is 2026-10-27, so 2030 hasn't happened. No public source can report an observed, exact 2030 share for NVIDIA. Only projections exist, and they disagree. Even for past years, "AI-chip market share" has no single agreed figure, because it depends on how analysts define the market.

**Observed (2024–2026, estimates by third parties, not audited figures)**

- NVIDIA's 2026 share of AI accelerator revenue is estimated at about 70–85%. The estimates vary by source and by what they count.
  https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026
  https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia

- NVIDIA's share is estimated to have peaked near 87% in 2024 and to have fallen since.
  https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026

- The definition changes the number. One source counts only merchant vendors (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and puts NVIDIA at 87.4% in Q1 2026. Counting custom ASICs lowers it.
  https://axis-intelligence.com/ai-chip-market-share/

- Custom ASICs (Google TPU, AWS Trainium, Microsoft Maia, Meta MTIA) are estimated at roughly 12–20% of revenue. By shipments they are larger: TrendForce projects ASIC-based AI servers at 27.8% of 2026 shipments. ASIC chips are mostly used in-house and are not sold, so revenue share is hard to measure.
  https://axis-intelligence.com/ai-chip-market-share/
  https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/semiconductors/custom-ai-asics-examined-from-broadcom-to-mtia

- AMD is estimated at about 5–8% of the market.
  https://siliconanalysts.com/analysis/nvidia-ai-accelerator-market-share-2024-2026

**Projections for 2030 (not observed outcomes)**

- Bloomberg Intelligence expects NVIDIA to hold 70–75% through 2030, with AMD at a minimum of about 10%.
  https://www.bloomberg.com/company/press/ai-accelerator-market-looks-set-to-exceed-600-billion-by-2033-driven-by-hyperscale-spending-and-asic-adoption-according-to-bloomberg-intelligence/

- Kearney, as cited by Celadon Research, projects a fall from about 90% in 2025 to 70% by 2030. I read this secondhand and did not check Kearney's original report.
  https://celadonresearch.com/research/nvidia-ai-accelerators-q1-2026

- Northwise Project, a low-authority site, gives 62% for NVIDIA in 2030, with AMD at 26% and ASICs at 12%.
  https://northwiseproject.com/research/ai-accelerator-market-forecast-2030

- The projections span roughly 62–75%. They use different definitions and assumptions, and some come from weak sources. The range itself shows that a single "exact" 2030 figure can't be established.

**Conclusion:** The question assumes an exact realized 2030 figure exists in public evidence. It doesn't. Even when 2030 data arrives, the result will be an estimate that depends on definitions: revenue or units, merchant chips only or including captive ASICs, and whether China is included.
